For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Ratan Datta, Advocate.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Raju Datta, P.P. Hon'Ble The Chief Justice Mr. Aparesh Kumar
Singh Order 15/03/2024

Petitioner is the wife of respondent No.1 who seeks transfer of R.K. Pur P.S. case No.2023WRP065 registered under Section 498A of the IPC on her complaint before Belonia Women P.S. from the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Udaipur, Gomati Tripura to the competent Court in Belonia in South Tripura District.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Udaipur, Gomati Tripura
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The marriage between the parties was solemnized on 27.11.2022.

However, alleging physical and mental torture, a zero F.I.R.
was registered before Belonia Women P.S. which is the parent place of the petitioner on 15.09.2023.
The same stood transferred to R.K. Pur Women P.S. under Gomati District where it was registered on 16.09.2023.
Petitioner apprehends threat at the hands of the respondents while prosecuting the case at Gomati.
Petitioner also contends that it was difficult for her to commute from Belonia to Gomati to prosecute and attend the case on every date.
The case has been instituted by her.
Therefore, it should be transferred to the competent Court at Belonia in South Tripura.
Issue notice on the respondents under ordinary process and speed post, for which requisites be filed within a week.
Mr. Raju Datta, learned Public Prosecutor, appears and waives notice on behalf of respondent No.2/State.
In the meantime, further proceedings in connection with PRC(WP) No.136 of 2023 pending before the Court of Judicial Magistrate 1 st Class, Udaipur, Gomati Tripura shall remain stayed.
